**"The Tunnel of Love"** (sometimes listed as "Tunnel of Love") is a song written and recorded by the group [Fun Boy Three](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fun_Boy_Three "Fun Boy Three"). It was the second single from their second album _[Waiting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waiting\_(Fun\_Boy\_Three\_album) "Waiting (Fun Boy Three album)")_ and returned the group to the UK top ten following the comparative failure of the album's first single "The More I See (The Less I Believe)", which had been their only single release to miss the UK top 40.

Both the single and album contain the same version of the song. However, on the album, [David Byrne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Byrne "David Byrne") is credited with production, while the single credits The Fun Boy Three with production, and David Byrne and Jeremy Green with mixing.

The B-side featured an alternative version of their debut single "The Lunatics (Have Taken Over the Asylum)", performed using only voices and [body percussion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Body_percussion "Body percussion").

**"The Tunnel of Love"** (sometimes listed as "Tunnel of Love") is a song written and recorded by the group [Fun Boy Three](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fun_Boy_Three "Fun Boy Three"). It was the second single from their second album _[Waiting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waiting\_(Fun\_Boy\_Three\_album) "Waiting (Fun Boy Three album)")_ and returned the group to the UK top ten following the comparative failure of the album's first single "The More I See (The Less I Believe)", which had been their only single release to miss the UK top 40.

Both the single and album contain the same version of the song. However, on the album, [David Byrne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Byrne "David Byrne") is credited with production, while the single credits The Fun Boy Three with production, and David Byrne and Jeremy Green with mixing.

The B-side featured an alternative version of their debut single "The Lunatics (Have Taken Over the Asylum)", performed using only voices and [body percussion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Body_percussion "Body percussion").
